## Command Syntax

```blitzbasic
TreeViewNodeText:String node:Int32
```

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `node` | Int32 | required | Handle of a node. |

**Returns:** The text of the node.
